title: Expo
notes: Expo Router API route, exported with `expo export --platform web` in server output mode and served by expo-server's Node http adapter. Only the API route is measured.
details: Built with expo export --platform web, with web.output set to "server" in app.json, which writes dist/server; expo-server's documented Node http adapter (createRequestHandler) serves that build from a node:http server inside the measured process, on Bun and Deno as on Node. The route is an Expo Router API route (app/api/items/[id]+api.js) returning Response.json(). The static and dynamic pages were left out: Expo renders pages with React Native components through react-native-web, which cannot produce the shared page's table, list and heading elements without writing raw DOM elements around the framework's own components. Telemetry is off.
